last_done_increment.summary: 2026-07-09: /en billing payment history now actually populates. Root cause: Polar sends the charged amount on order.* events (created/paid/updated/refunded), but the webhook processed only subscription.* and tried to read amount/invoice off subscription payloads (absent in real Polar), so paying customers saw 'No payment history yet.'. Fix: app/lib/polarOrder.ts (dependency-free, unit-tested mapping order->payment row: status, total_amount-preferred amount, currency; skips $0/no-amount) + webhook now handles order.* with an idempotent upsert on the order id (payments.polarPaymentId unique), links to the subscription when present, logs payment_done. subscription.* lifecycle handling unchanged (no double-record: order id != subscription invoice id, and real subscription events carry no amount). Verified green: tsc, eslint, npm test 9/9, next build; /api/polar/webhook registered. Preceded by GLO-HARDEN (a1e8f62): testable route handlers, xlsx dropped for in-house csv.ts, next 15.5.20, tsx test runner + precommit harness.
